'''Marcus Wood Han Will Have That Shield Down!''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Marcus Wood]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls126.htm Han Will Have That Shield Down!], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010114020800/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls126.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Marcus Wood]]

* '''Published:''' [[Trandosite]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
